text: While posted near {Place}, military engineer {Name} approved an unsafe bridge repair. The bridge collapsed, killing two comrades. Since then, the engineer has personally checked every repair before allowing soldiers to cross.
self_review: A military engineer approved a fatal bridge repair and subsequently began checking every repair personally.
source_pattern: Plausible invention; the supplied research does not document this accident or engineering habit.
fictional_changes: The military career, fatal repair decision, and checking habit are fictional.
